question_or_proposition: For Ceriodaphnia dubia whole effluent toxicity testing under Outfall 001, does the VALUE entry "Report" indicate that Part I specifies report-only monitoring with no enforceable numeric discharge limit for compliance comparison, or that an enforceable numeric limit applicable to Ceriodaphnia dubia WET results must be taken from elsewhere in the permit (such as Part II WET pass/fail criteria referenced in footnote (3))?
required_context: Part I Whole Effluent Toxicity table for Outfall 001 (Ceriodaphnia dubia row: VALUE, MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY, SAMPLE TYPE columns)
Part I footnote (3) cross-reference to Part II WET testing requirements and additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions
Contrast with other Part I table rows where "Report" appears alongside separate numeric limits in other limit columns
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf page 4, section part_i, WET table, Ceriodaphnia dubia row, VALUE column
notes: The nominated span is the single word "Report" in the WET VALUE column. Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring; resolving what "Report" means here determines whether Ceriodaphnia dubia WET measurements can be compared against an applicable numeric limit or are report-only for limit purposes.
